extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Storage of water — water is stored in clay pots (matka), steel containers, plastic bottles, buckets, drums, water tanks. Clay pots keep water cool naturally. Water should be covered to keep dust and germs out. (2) Simple properties of water — pure water has no colour, no taste, no smell. Water is transparent (we can see through it). Water takes the shape of the container it is in. Water flows from high to low. (3) Water conservation — close taps while brushing teeth, fix leaking taps, use a bucket instead of a shower for bathing, collect rainwater, do not waste water while washing dishes. (4) Vessels and containers — clay pot (matka) for cool drinking water, steel container for kitchen, plastic bottle for carrying, bucket for bathing, water tank for storing large amounts. Misconceptions: 'water is blue' (pure water has no colour, the sea looks blue because of the sky reflection), 'water has taste' (pure water has no taste, if water tastes different it has something mixed in it), 'leaking tap wastes very little water' (a leaking tap can waste many litres of water in a day), 'clay pot makes water dirty' (clay pot keeps water cool and is safe for drinking if cleaned regularly). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function WaterGame), NOT export default. Export interface WaterGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
